The jewel of the orchard.

One fruit, picked on the day it ripens.

Split open by the sun.

Our pomegranates crack on the branch when they are ready.

Hundreds of rubies, one skin.

Every seed is lifted from its pith by hand, never pressed.

Juice that shines.

Sweet, bright and clear, from the first bite.

One seed. One drop.

Fruit worth slowing down for.

Anaar pomegranates are grown in small orchards, chosen one by one and packed in boxes of twelve. Each box arrives within two days of picking.

Chosen by hand

We keep only fruit with deep colour, firm skin and a full, heavy weight.

Picked ripe

Nothing is ripened in a warehouse. The fruit is cut from the tree at its best.

Packed to gift

A black, felt-lined box with a card, ready to give or to keep.
